description:
Introducing an exclusive collection of 13 one-of-a-kind luxury Mijas Costa townhouses for sale with sea views, where Scandinavian design harmonises with the peaceful embrace of nature. Situated in a highly sought-after area, this location offers exceptional convenience and accessibility, putting everything you need within easy reach. Whether you are commuting or exploring the region, excellent transport links make getting around effortless.

These south-facing, energy-efficient townhouses offer stunning panoramic sea views. Each home is meticulously designed using premium materials and trusted brands, featuring contemporary interiors with sleek gourmet kitchens, elegant designer bathrooms, and underfloor heating throughout. From the rooftop terraces with a private jacuzzi, you can unwind and enjoy sweeping views of the sea and magnificent Mijas Costa sunsets.

The meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to high energy efficiency truly set this project apart, reflecting a forward-thinking approach that aligns with the growing global focus on sustainability. In addition to the eco-friendly design, the inclusion of an onsite gym and a social club encourages a sense of community and well-being among residents, making these homes an ideal choice for eco-conscious homeowners seeking a modern, sustainable lifestyle with a strong community spirit.

Situated beside a vibrant green space, this residential complex boasts meticulously landscaped gardens, complemented by a park filled with trees and winding pathways, perfect for leisurely strolls and enjoying the refreshing sea breeze. The thoughtful landscaping blends harmoniously with the natural environment, creating a serene and tranquil setting for residents to unwind and connect with nature.

Situated in the desirable Mijas Costa, everything you need is within reach. Excellent transport links, proximity to Marbella, just 20 minutes from Puerto Banus, and a quick 25-minute drive to the airport make it a convenient location. The beach, gourmet dining options, and a variety of premium amenities, including golf courses, tennis and padel courts, as well as schools, and a children’s playground, are all conveniently located nearby.

This project is an extraordinary opportunity to experience an unparalleled lifestyle in perfect balance with nature—don’t miss your chance to make one of these exclusive townhouses yours!
